text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*whew*... We got in a solid session today!
Good work.
choice_data_list: Make sure you get plenty of rest.
Make sure you get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
For days with exceptionally heavy workouts, I brought my favorite bath pillow!
Time to relax to the fullest~!
choice_data_list: Don't stay in the bath too long, alright?
Don't stay in the bath too long, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Almond Eye off as she headed back to the lodge, I turned my gaze toward the beach. With the training camp nearing its end, most of the Umamusume were putting on the final touches, but—
choice_data_list: (Is she still going to keep at it...?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Phew...... ngh.
Just one... more set......

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Just one, more rep...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Because I want to win no matter what!
Don't you?”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……Yer not wrong.
……Even so, though……

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
To be blown away
so easily like that............

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
...Orfe-san—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Ah... P-Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...So you're biting back.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—Hmph...!
Haaaaaaah...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!?
Y-You gotta be kiddin' me............!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...? Orfe-san,
back then, you were seriously—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I have no interest in the weak.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Answer me.
—Are you a loser?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—...I might be... a loser.
But..., but...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—The dream of the Triple Tiara is gone.
I know all too well I just wasn't good enough...”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Then you are indeed a loser.
—You have no right to sit upon the throne.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
WRONG!!!!
I'm—... I am the true queen!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh, noooo...!!
Argh, everything's totally messed up now!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye...!
Seriously, what even are you!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You already won! It's your win!
And yet you still wanna beat me? I don't get you at all!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I mean, what do you mean "come to think of it"?!
It's the Triple Tiara!
A once-in-a-lifetime, glamorous stage that you can only challenge once!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And yet—saying you're not even interested in aiming for victory?!
I wanted that... more than anything in the world!
And yet, and yet... I...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—If only I was stronger...!
I wouldn't have let Ai-san do whatever she wanted...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san, it frustrates me so much...!
I was the one—
who was worthy of the Triple Tiara!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to win!
I want to wear the crown! I want to be the queen...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna let it end
with them snatching everything from me, damn it all!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Then, pursue us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Follow behind this greatest king,
and no one shall ever stand equal to you."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Catch up to Orfe...
you're saying, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
True, if I can do that—no one can match me.
...I can reign supreme. If that's the case, then I'll—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The morning of the final day of summer camp.
In just a few hours, we'd be heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
...First, I'd like to hear your evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I wonder... Did I manage to grow properly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye seemed somewhat anxious.
She couldn't say she tackled this summer training camp in top shape.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Aaaaaaaaaahhh...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
Just now—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Not yet, not yet...
I can't even step on her shadow yet...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I'll drill it right into 'em.
The peak of running... into these legs...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: More... more... more... nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Aaaah... Haaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I've never seen Lara like that before.
choice_data_list: You're really pushing yourself hard, huh...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
…………Trainer.
Would it be all right if I train until the bus arrives after all?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I won't push myself too hard.
...Please.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac is a fantastic Umamusume.
Even so, I wondered a bit why Almond Eye was so fixated on her, but—
choice_data_list: (That competitive spirit feels a little familiar—)

text_block_list.name: Ai & Lala
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Good work to you too, Almond Eye-san.
Things really got down to the wire for both of us, huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You made it in time, so it's all good!
So, how did training camp go?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you.
I finally got myself a good record.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—At the Shuka Sho...
I might end up surprising you, Miss Eye.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm looking forward to that!
I can hardly wait for the race...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Hehe.
Me too."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Looks like they're coming out soon. Hey, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You worked so hard alongside me, after all.
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (...Together, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I have to win the Shuka Sho!
—For your sake, too."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (I was truly—shocked, you know.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (To 'want to win' for someone else's sake...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry.
I will absolutely—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, it'll be my turn.
Without a doubt—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Two powerful wills—heading toward the Shuka Sho.
